study type: Repeated cross-sectional analysis using secondary survey data
cohort: The study analyzes data related to mothers across all districts of West Bengal, India, derived from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS) 4 and 5.
finding: The study found a notable enhancement in maternal health outcomes and a decrease in disparities in West Bengal, with factors influencing maternal health shifting from infrastructure-related issues to household practices between 2015-16 and 2019-21.
